attributes.board_name: Nebraska DHHS Licensure Unit – Board of Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs at state and national meetings, formally organized courses/presentations, home study with a provider-scored test (0.5 h per 30 min), accredited college courses (1 semester credit = 15 h, 1 quarter credit = 10 h), publications (5 h each, max 10 h), specialty certification exam (10 h), presenting (initial presentation only, max 4 h), poster sessions. All 20 hours may be Content Area I (basic processes, disorders, evaluation, habilitation/rehabilitation); max 5 hours from Content Area II (regulations, service delivery, ethics, supervision, related disciplines, reimbursement). The Board does not pre-approve programs.
rules.alternatives: Current ASHA certification satisfies the CE requirement for the preceding 24-month period (documentation: current certification).
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE is waived for individuals first credentialed within the 24 months before the renewal date.
rules.audit_note: Renewal requirements per 172 NAC 10; keep certificates of attendance and program outlines/objectives as documentation.
rules.notes: All audiologist and SLP licenses expire Dec 1 of even-numbered years; 20 hours in the preceding 24 months. Not acceptable: marketing/business operations, personal self-improvement, courses for lay persons, courses under 30 minutes, case conferences and facility tours.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Formal or informal in-service training directly related to the services provided by the assistant.
rules.notes: Assistants are registered; registrations expire one year from the date of issuance, but the continuing competency rule requires at least 10 hours of in-service training on or before Dec 1 of each even-numbered year (the counting period is not stated; 24 months assumed from the even-year cycle).
